scope.purpose: Add per-device tie-break (updatedByDevice) to the task reducer's LWW gate AND the bootstrap snapshot merge gate, so two devices sharing a Nostr pubkey can deterministically converge on concurrent same-timestamp edits. Optional companion: subscribe to the new marmot-ts MIP-03 rollback event and re-issue locally-sent task events from the discarded branch.

constraints: Do NOT weaken the reducer back to >=. The strict > is what makes the inter-author case converge under reorder.
The new field updatedByDevice MUST be optional on Task and TaskEvent (backward compat for persisted IDB rows). Missing/undefined treated as '' (sorts lowest) at every comparison site.

Apply the three-level tie-break identically at ALL 5 enumerated merge gates: 4 reducer mutation arms in src/store/task-reducer.ts AND the bootstrap snapshot merge gate in src/marmot/device-sync.ts. Missing any one gate causes silent divergence at that gate.
Stamp updatedByDevice at a single chokepoint (dispatch() in task-store.tsx), not threaded through every producer. The accessor is client.keyPackages.clientId per the marmot-ts API.
Preserve the existing ensureMonotonicTimestamp helper from task-store-utils.ts. The new field must round-trip through its spread return.

If layer 2 (rollback listener) is included, the handler's signature MUST match the actual emitted RollbackInfo shape from marmot-ts dist (groupId, targetEpoch, newHeadCommitEventId, invalidatedMessages: string[]). The library does NOT pass decoded application data — only invalidated event IDs.
non_goals: Cross-kind reorder convergence (EDIT vs COMPLETE at overlapping timestamps). Out of scope for this bug; tracked as a separate known limitation in the property tests.
Healing existing diverged groups in the wild. marmot-ts MIP-03 commit message: 'Existing forked groups do not auto-heal.'
The known sibling-forget bug (sibling-forget-fails-multi-device-same) at the MLS layer.
Replacing or augmenting the existing ensureMonotonicTimestamp helper — it addresses an orthogonal axis (sequential same-actor) and must stay as-is.
regression_guards: Full vitest suite (`make test`) must pass with no regressions vs baseline counts.
Existing property tests in task-reducer.property.test.ts and multi-client.property.test.ts must still pass.
Existing ensureMonotonicTimestamp tests in task-store.monotonic.test.ts must still pass.
Production build (`make build`) must typecheck cleanly (whole-program tsc, not per-file vitest transpile).

If layer 2 (rollback listener) is implemented, it must not cause runtime errors on any rollback emission, including when invalidatedMessages is empty (the S2 default per marmot-ts d.ts comment 'S2 emits RollbackInfo with empty arrays for both fields').
note: Contract written by lead after the fixer delivered without it, to support the reviewer step. The contract is intentionally permissive on layer 2: per VQ11, layer 2 may be implemented OR explicitly deferred with reasoning, but if attempted, it must match the actual emitted RollbackInfo shape.
